body.p: Please amend the current claims as follows:
body.br:
1. (Currently Amended) A fastening system for attachingconfigured to attach a fixture to a monument provided for installation in a passenger cabin, such that a wall portion of the monument has at least two first fastening elements, comprising:
a wall portion of the monument which has at least one first fastening element; and a frame which has at least one twosecond fastening elementelements and which is configured to cover the fixture at least in part in a fastened state;
wherein the at least two first fastening element elements and the at least two second fastening element elements are configured to engage with one another and be movable relative to one another in a pre-assembled state, and to fix one another in the fastened state,
wherein the fastened state can be produced in that, in the pre-assembled state, the frame is moved relative to the wall portion in a fastening direction which extends at least substantially parallel to a main extension plane of the wall portionvertically downward until the at least two first fastening elements engage respective ones of the at least two second fastening elements,
wherein each of the at least two first fastening elements are displaced from one another along the fastening direction, and wherein each of the at least two second fastening elements are displaced from one another along the fastening direction.
2. (Currently Amended) The fastening system according to claim 1, wherein the at least two first fastening element elements and the at least two second fastening element elements are configured to make it possible to produce the pre-assembled state in that the frame is moved towards the wall portion in an assembly direction which extends substantially perpendicularly to the main extension plane of the wall portion.
3. (Currently Amended) The fastening system according to The fastening system according to
wherein, in the fastened state, at least one of:
the at least two first fastening element elements engages behind the at least two second fastening elementelements, or the at least two second fastening element elements engages behind the at least two first fastening elementelements.
4. (Currently Amended) The fastening system according to claim 1, wherein at least one of the at least two first fastening element elements or the at least two second fastening element elements is formed as a hook element.
5. (Currently Amended) The fastening system according to claim 1, wherein the at least two first fastening element elements and the at least two second fastening elementelements are configured to be released from one another in that, starting from the fastened state, the frame is moved relative to the wall portion counter to the fastening direction.
6. (Original) The fastening system according to claim 1, wherein the frame is configured to retain the fixture, at least in part.
7. (Original) The fastening system according to claim 1, further comprising a locking unit which, in a locked state, is configured to prevent a release of the fastened state and, in a released state, is configured to allow the release of the fastened state.
8. (Original) The fastening system according to claim 7, wherein the locking unit comprises at least one blocking element which, in the locked state, mechanically prevents a movement of the frame relative to the wall portion.
9. (Currently Amended) The fastening system according to The fastening system according to
wherein the frame has a first opening,
wherein the wall portion has a second opening which aligns with the first opening in thefastenedstate, and wherein the second opening is misaligned with the first opening in the pre-assembled state, and
wherein the blocking element extends through the first opening and the second opening, at least in part, in the locked state.
10. (Withdrawn) The fastening system according to The fastening system according to
wherein the locking unit has an actuation mechanism having an actuation member arranged at a distance from the blocking element and a force transmission mechanically coupling the actuation member to the blocking element, and
wherein the blocking element is movable via the actuation member.
11. (Withdrawn) The fastening system according to claim 10, wherein the actuation member is biased into a locking position via a spring element.
12. (Currently Amended) The fastening system according to The fastening system according to
wherein, in the fastened state, the frame covers the at least two first fastening elements and at least two second fastening elements in an opaque manner.
13. (Cancelled)
14. (Original) A monument provided for installation in a passenger cabin comprising a fastening system according to A monument provided for installation in a passenger cabin comprising a fastening system according to
a fixture which is attached via the fastening system.
15. (Currently Amended) A method for attaching a fixture to a monument provided for installation in a passenger cabin via a fastening system which includes a wall portion of the monument which has at least one two first fastening elementelements, and a
frame which has at least one two second fastening element elements and which is configured to retain the fixture, at least in part, in a fastened state, comprising the steps of:producing a pre-assembled state in which the at least two first fastening element elements and the at least two second fastening element elements engage with one another and are movable relative to one another; and
moving the frame in the pre-assembled state relative to the wall portion in a fastening direction which extends at least substantially parallel to a main extension plane of the wall portion vertically downward until the at least two first fastening elements engage respective ones of the at least two second fastening elements to produce the fastened state in which the first fastening element and the second fastening element fix one another,
wherein each of the at least two first fastening elements are displaced from one another along the fastening direction, and wherein each of the at least two second fastening elements are displaced from one another along the fastening direction.
16. (Currently Amended) The fastening system monument according toclaim 1claim 14,wherein the fixture comprises a display.
17. (Currently Amended) The fastening system monument according toclaim 1claim 14,wherein the passenger cabin is a passenger cabin of an aircraft.
18. (New) The monument according to claim 14, wherein the fixture further comprises two connection members which are introduced into corresponding receptacles of the wall portion.
19. (New) The fastening system according to claim 9, wherein the frame has a third opening, and the wall portion has a fourth opening which aligns with the third opening in the fastened state,
wherein the locking unit further comprises at least one second blocking element which, in the locked state, mechanically prevents a movement of the frame relative to the
wall portion, wherein the at least one second blocking unit extends through the third opening and the fourth opening, at least in part, in the locked state, andwherein the third and fourth openings extend in a direction perpendicular to an extension direction of the first and second openings.
20. (New) A fastening system attaching a fixture to a monument provided for installation in a passenger cabin, comprising:
a monument which has a wall portion with at least two first fastening elements;
a frame which has at least two second fastening elements and which is configured to cover the fixture at least in part in a fastened state;
wherein the at least two first fastening elements and the at least two second fastening elements are configured to engage with one another and be movable relative to one another in a pre-assembled state, and to fix one another in the fastened state,
wherein, in the pre-assembled state, the frame is moved relative to the wall portion in a fastening direction which extends vertically downward until the at least two first fastening elements engage respective ones of the at least two second fastening elements, and
wherein each of the at least two first fastening elements are displaced from one another along the fastening direction, and wherein each of the at least two second fastening elements are displaced from one another along the fastening direction.
